turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
very location. For a small parcel, delivery is usually within 48 to 72 hours. A mattress ordered alone, without removal services, qualifies for express delivery within 48 hours.

The tracking number is generated when your order leaves the warehouse and is handed to the carrier. With some carriers, the tracking link may only be sent on the morning of the delivery day, or even up to one hour before the courier arrives.

Please send me your order number so I can tell you what applies to your order.

turns.q: Once it ships, how long is delivery?
turns.replyTail:
Once your order has been handed to the carrier, delivery time depends on the products and your delivery location:

Small parcels: usually 48 to 72 hours, delivered to the ground floor.
A mattress ordered alone, without removal services: express delivery within 48 hours.

For other products, the estimated delivery date is shown in the “Ma livraison dès le...” section on the product page. The carrier’s tracking link will provide the most accurate update once it is available.

turns.q: Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
turns.replyTail:
Unfortunately, we cannot speed up or bring forward the delivery date once the order has been placed. It will be delivered within the time window communicated when you ordered. The delivery driver may call as they approach or if you are absent.

If you would like me to check your order’s specific delivery details, please send your order number.

turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
turns.replyTail: If the tracking does not update, first check the carrier’s tracking link for the latest status. To check your order specifically, please send your order number, the email address used for the purchase, and the phone number used when ordering.

turns.q: How do I find my tracking link?
turns.replyTail:
Log in to your Tediber account, then open Mes Commandes. Your tracking number and link appear there once the order has left the warehouse and been handed to the carrier.

Depending on the carrier, the link may only arrive on the morning of delivery or up to one hour before the courier arrives. If you do not see it, send me your order number, purchase email address, and phone number so I can check the order.

turns.q: Do you compensate for a long delay?
turns.replyTail:
Compensation is not automatic for a delayed delivery. Each request must be reviewed based on the order and what happened.

Please send your order number, the email address used for the purchase, the phone number used when ordering, and the promised delivery date or current tracking status. This will allow the delay and any compensation request to be assessed.
